description: Golden-output regression cases for the hyphy3 CLI. Each case runs `hyphy3 <subcommand> <args>` with --output pointed at a temp file; the emitted modern (v3) JSON is canonicalized (keys sorted, floats rounded, volatile fields masked) and compared against the committed snapshot tests/golden/<name>.json. Paths in args are relative to the repository root. 'tier' controls which runs include the case: fast cases run in regular CI, slow cases run in the 'deep' tier (nightly / full-ci PRs). 'source' records the provenance of input data per project data-handling rules.

cases.name: fel_cd2
cases.source: CD2 codon alignment + {Group1-4}-tagged tree, HyPhy benchmark data (benchmarks/data/cd2.fna, cd2.nwk)

cases.name: meme_cd2
cases.source: CD2 codon alignment + tagged tree (benchmarks/data/cd2.fna, cd2.nwk)

cases.name: slac_cd2
cases.source: CD2 codon alignment + tagged tree (benchmarks/data/cd2.fna, cd2.nwk); --samples 0 disables stochastic ancestral-state confidence-interval sampling for determinism
